name: helpdesk-webapp

dependencies.name: helpdesk-api
dependencies.description: Loads and changes tickets, comments and the queue.

description: One React single-page app for all three roles (Employee, Support Agent, Team Lead): ticket raising and tracking, the agent queue and ticket workspace, and the team-lead queue view. It signs users in via SSO and calls helpdesk-api; role-specific screens are gated by the operation each loads. It holds no data of its own and no secrets.
